notes: Segment covers all 25 High Courts of India. Chief Justice data was cross-verified across three sources that disagreed on 2026-09-24/25: the Wikipedia 'High courts of India' summary table (edited 2026-09-24, but its CJ column proved STALE for 7 HCs — Bombay, Calcutta, Chhattisgarh, J&K/Ladakh, MP, Punjab & Haryana, Rajasthan — still showing pre-appointment acting CJs), versus the per-judge seniority table on 'List of sitting judges of the high courts of India' (edited same-day 2026-09-25) and 'List of current Indian chief justices' (edited 2026-09-12), which were independently corroborated via Google News RSS swearing-in reports (The Hindu, NDTV, Live Law, SCC Online, New Indian Express, Bar & Bench) confirming a batch of 8 new (non-acting) Chief Justice appointments notified 2026-09-07/13 (Bombay: M.C. Tripathi; Calcutta: R.V. Ghuge; Chhattisgarh: K.R. Mohapatra; J&K and Ladakh: P.S. Bhati; MP: A.Y. Kogje; Patna: V.K. Rao; Punjab & Haryana: A.K. Mishra; Rajasthan: S.K. Agrawal). The seniority-table data was used as the final answer; none of the 25 HCs currently has an acting CJ per this reconciliation. Sanctioned/working/vacancy figures are per the DoJ 'Statement showing Sanctioned strength, Working Strength and Vacancies of Judges...' dated 2026-07-01 (as reproduced/cited in the sitting-judges Wikipedia table); doj.gov.in itself is bot-protected (JS challenge) and could not be fetched directly with curl/WebFetch in this session, so figures are one level removed from the primary PDF — confidence 'high' but flagged for a follow-up direct-PDF check. KNOWN GAPS: (1) State Judicial Academy entities use standard/public-knowledge names for the academy of each HC's principal state, NOT individually re-verified against each academy's own website this pass — treat as confidence:low placeholders pending verification (officialUrl/established year deliberately omitted rather than invented). (2) District & subordinate judiciary aggregate entities are created per HC per the brief, but sanctioned district-judge strength could not be sourced (would require the National Judicial Data Grid or a state-wise DoJ subordinate-judiciary vacancy statement, both effectively inaccessible without browser tools) — seats left null, confidence:low, not invented. (3) officialUrl and legalSourceUrl are omitted for all 25 High Court entities rather than guessed/invented; a follow-up pass should pull each HC's official domain from its own Wikipedia infobox or judiciary.gov.in. (4) Bombay HC's Kolhapur bench is listed without a confirmed permanent/circuit classification — Wikipedia's footnote marker was missing/ambiguous for that entry specifically. (5) WebSearch tool quota was exhausted early in this run (shared across the parallel multi-agent research session before this segment started); all verification after that point relied on Wikipedia parse API, WebFetch, and Google News RSS via curl instead.

entities.name: District & Subordinate Judiciary of Uttarakhand

Sanctioned district-judge strength could not be independently verified in this research pass (needs the National Judicial Data Grid or state-wise DoJ subordinate-judiciary statement); see top-level notes.
